source.check: every figure read from the page image; * marks the old members

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1905: polled 25 May 1905 in five divisions (counted 26 May by T. W. Kilpatrick, returning officer). Markethill is not filed: both Armagh Guardian nomination lists print "Markethill—Wm. Simpson, J.P.", the Hamiltonsbawn member, apparently in error. The Armagh Guardian marks both Larkin and Rice as old members; Rice was returned in 1902. The Frontier Sentinel (27 May 1905, p. 5) gives Larkin 396, Fearon 103 in its OCR text; the Armagh Guardian image figures are used. Most spoilt papers in the election were in Forkhill.
